name: PATEO CONNECT Technology (Shanghai) Corporation
summary: PATEO CONNECT Technology (Shanghai) Corporation develops smart cockpit solutions and vehicle connectivity services for automakers and Tier-1 suppliers in China and Hong Kong, along with telematics terminals and cloud platforms. Its offerings include automotive electronics, operating system software, voice AI, map integration, and cloud services for vehicle payment and connected, autonomous, shared and electric vehicles. Founded in 2009 in Shanghai, it was formerly Shanghai Pateo Electronic Equipment Manufacturing Co., Ltd.
